title: Managed non-Dream Gemini Flash after reservation cutover

model.expr: (sum(increase(omi_vertex_managed_25_attempts_total{traffic_type=~"shared|on_demand"}[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(omi_vertex_managed_25_on_demand_responses_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(omi_vertex_non_dream_flash_after_cutover_attempts_total[5m])) or vector(0)) > bool 0

annotations.summary: Any non-Dream Gemini Flash generation attempt after the order moved, or any managed 2.5 shared/on-demand attempt, is a regression.
annotations.threshold: Any positive increase in a 5 minute window; no volume or pending-duration threshold.
annotations.scope: Company-paid non-Dream generation only after observed exclusive-order move; all Flash models and capacity modes, including blocked dispatches. Dream, BYOK, embeddings and synthetic dedicated discovery are excluded from the cutover series.
annotations.user_impact: Non-Dream requests may consume Dream reservation capacity or unreserved Gemini spend.
annotations.verification: Check omi_vertex_non_dream_flash_after_cutover_attempts_total by model, traffic_type and lane alongside routing decisions and reservation evidence.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect the INACTIVE destination table and dispatch guard. Keep every serving non-Dream row on Luna; never restore a Gemini remap.
